Magic Staffs Mod

A progression-based magic mod featuring custom staffs, powerful abilities, and a full crafting system built around a custom magic machine.

Guide

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vmC130oQVX0

Progress

I made ABOUT 12 Custom Recipes for my Custom Block Entity.

Here's the full breakdown of items, crafting system, and staff powers.

Core Items

Magic Gem

The Magic Gem is the main requirement for crafting almost all staffs and advanced magic items. It acts as the core energy source for the entire system.

Arcane Runes (Magic Station)

The Arcane Runes are the magic crafting station used to create and upgrade staffs. All progression and staff crafting happens through this block entity.

Staff Progression

Tier 1 Staff (Basic)

Gives nice buffs when right-clicked.

Tier 2 Staff

Gives improved buffs when right-clicked and slightly stronger magic effects.

Tier 3 Staff (Lightning Staff)

Summons lightning strikes on targets and deals high electric damage.

Tier 4 Staff (Fireball Staff)

Shoots explosive fireballs that deal area damage and burn enemies.

Tier 5 Staff (Ice Staff)

Fires ice blasts that slow and freeze enemies in place.

Tier 6 Staff (Water Staff)

Controls water energy to push enemies and create knockback effects.

Tier 7 Staff (Lava Staff)

Launches molten lava attacks that deal heavy burning damage over time.

Tier 8 Staff (Blinker / Teleport Staff)

Allows instant teleportation short distances for fast movement and escaping danger.

Tier 9 Staff (DESTROYER Staff)

Extremely powerful destructive magic that deals massive area damage.

Tier 10 Staff (Ghost / Invisibility Staff)

Makes the player invisible and allows stealth-based gameplay and escaping detection.

That's all for now.

I REALLY enjoyed making this mod and learning how to create full magic systems in Minecraft.

The journey was worth it.
